purpose: Record applicability and evidence-backed verdicts for OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 chapter V13 (Configuration) — 21 requirements — in the machine-readable decision register, with no code changes and no attempt to close the FAIL verdicts found in this pass.
requiredInvariants: Every V13 requirement gets a decision: APPLICABLE with PASS/FAIL, or NOT_ASSESSED with a named blocker; none is silently skipped.
A PASS is only recorded where the enforcing code was re-read on the live tree in this pass, not inferred from an earlier chapter's finding.
A downstream FAIL that depends on another requirement's absence (V13.2.6 on V13.1.2/V13.1.3) says so explicitly rather than repeating the underlying finding as if independent.
The edge-configuration blocker (Caddy config not in the repository) is used only for genuinely edge-dependent requirements, consistent with its use in V4/V11/V12/V14/V16.
No security control is weakened; Semgrep, the pinning ratchet and every other gate stay at full strength.
No production, REG.RU, DNS or database mutation.

This scope changes no application code — findings that name real gaps (ML-client zero authentication, unallowlisted partner-webhook dispatch, latent Vault client, unauthenticated /version disclosure) are recorded as evidence, not remediated here.
acceptance: docs/security/asvs-applicability-decisions.json gains exactly 21 new V13.* decisions and no duplicates.
The evidence gate rejects 0 decisions; decisionsApplied increases by 21; finalPass stays false.
scripts/security/*.test.mjs stays 60/60 (JSON-only change, no script logic touched).
Every FAIL and PASS note cites a real file and pattern that was checked against the live tree in this pass.
The three edge-dependent requirements (V13.4.3, V13.4.4, V13.4.7) are NOT_ASSESSED with the same edge-topology blocker used elsewhere.
V13.2.2 (staff database-principal boundary) and V13.2.3 (no default credentials) are recorded PASS with evidence distinct from any FAIL in the same subsection.
